senses.sense_definition: A type of white blood cell that can develop into a macrophage to help the immune system.

examples.text: The <w>monocyte</w> travels through the bloodstream before entering tissues to become a macrophage.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>单核细胞</w>在进入组织并转化为巨噬细胞之前，会随血液循环流动。

examples.text: Doctors often check the <w>monocyte</w> count to see how the body is fighting an infection.

target_lang_translations.zh: 医生经常检查<w>单核细胞</w>计数，以观察身体如何对抗感染。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种白细胞，可以发育为巨噬细胞以帮助免疫系统。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 生物学中指血液中体积最大的白细胞。
